verdict.rationale: Founder Law states an employer-side offering: H-1B, L-1 and employment-based visas "to hire and retain global teams," plus a corporate immigration practice covering employee H-1B extensions and amendments. So a growing startup could plausibly route team visas through this one firm. However, the evidence describes per-petition flat-fee packages and gives no multi-case management tooling, volume or team pricing, or dedicated scale-up sponsorship program. Missing for 10: a documented multi-case or team management workflow, team or volume package terms, a stated scale-up employer program, and independent corroboration of team-scale engagements.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases

citations.quote: H-1B, L-1, and employment-based visas to hire and retain global teams.
Extensions, amendments, and H-1Bs for employees to consult at client sites are also possible.
We help specialty workers and their employers navigate the H-1B visa transfer and lottery process.
